davx.description:
DAVx⁵ is an open-source synchronization app for Android that connects your contacts, calendars, and tasks to compatible online services and self-hosted servers using the standard CardDAV and CalDAV protocols.

Keep your address books and calendars synchronized with Android applications while remaining in control of where your personal data is stored. DAVx⁵ supports automatic account discovery, configurable synchronization settings, multiple accounts, and integration with compatible task applications. It also enables access to WebDAV files through Android's Storage Access Framework, allowing supported file managers and applications to work with remote files.

DAVx⁵ works with a variety of CalDAV, CardDAV, and WebDAV services, including many self-hosted groupware solutions. Its open-source design and support for standard protocols make it useful for people who prefer interoperable services instead of relying on a single proprietary ecosystem.

A compatible server or service account is required. DAVx⁵ provides synchronization rather than a standalone calendar, contacts manager, or task editor. Task support depends on a compatible Android task application.
